title: GRASPING FOR WHAT ONLY GOD GIVES

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, 'Please give me some of your son's mandrakes.' But she said to her, 'Wasn't it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son's mandrakes too?' 'Very well,' Rachel said, 'he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son's mandrakes.' So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. 'You must sleep with me,' she said. 'I have hired you with my son's mandrakes.' So he slept with her that night." - Gen 30:14-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The rivalry now reaches a strange low point. Reuben finds some mandrakes — plants people then believed could help a woman conceive. Rachel, still childless and desperate, bargains for them, trading a night with Jacob to get them. The two sisters are now negotiating over their husband and haggling over a folk remedy, each grasping for a child by her own means.

But here is the quiet irony of the story. Rachel gets her mandrakes — yet it is Leah who conceives that night, while Rachel still does not. The mandrakes did not "work." Rachel's clever bargain gained her nothing, because children do not come from plants or schemes. They come from God, who gives life according to His own will and timing.

We can be a lot like Rachel — grasping at every method, remedy, and shortcut to secure what we long for, as if the answer lies in our own cleverness. But some things simply cannot be manufactured. They are gifts we can only receive from God's hand.

Where are you scheming for something that only God can give? Loosen your grip on the shortcuts, and bring your longing to the Lord. He is the Giver of every good gift (Jas 1:17), and He can be trusted with the desires of your heart.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where am I grasping for something only God can give?
2. What "mandrakes" — shortcuts or remedies — am I trusting instead of God?
3. Can I loosen my grip and receive from God's hand in His timing?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, forgive me for grasping at shortcuts to get what only You can give. Help me to loosen my grip, to trust Your timing, and to receive every good gift from Your hand. Amen.
